subject: cpc
subject_name: Civil Procedure Code & Law of Limitation
summary: An analysis of the collected exam papers for Civil Procedure Code & Law of Limitation reveals a heavy concentration on core procedural concepts such as jurisdiction, execution of decrees, limitation principles, pleadings, and res judicata. Questions are consistently distributed across different tiers, including short-answer structural questions (Part A), broad essay topics requiring detailed conceptual explanations (Part B), and practical problem-based scenario questions (Part C). High-weighted topics typically dominate the long-form and problem-solving sections due to their substantial mark allocation and frequency across multiple years.
